name: ELIX Settings
description: System preferences, appearance customization, security sandboxing, AI runtime limits, and cache management for ELIX OS

get_system_settings.name: get_system_settings
get_system_settings.description: Retrieve current configuration parameters filtered by category (appearance, security, ai_bridge, defaults, notifications, or all)

update_setting.name: update_setting
update_setting.description: Update a specific configuration value and persist changes to system configuration store

value.description: New setting value (string, number, boolean, or object)

reset_settings_category.name: reset_settings_category
reset_settings_category.description: Restore all configuration keys in a specific category to factory defaults

category.description: Category to reset to default values

manage_permissions.name: manage_permissions
manage_permissions.description: Grant or revoke security permissions for target applications

clear_system_caches.name: clear_system_caches
clear_system_caches.description: Purge temporary storage files, application caches, thumbnail indexes, and log files

targetCaches.description: List of cache partitions to purge

export_configuration.name: export_configuration
export_configuration.description: Export system preferences and application associations to a JSON or encrypted backup archive
